## ✨ Added

- **The production image moves to OpenCloud 9.1.** `production` and `latest` follow OpenCloud's new production line and bring 9.1.1 instead of 7.2.6. You get guest access by email, end-to-end encrypted vaults, a search that needs far less memory and everything else in OpenCloud's [9.1.1 release notes](https://github.com/opencloud-eu/opencloud/releases/tag/v9.1.1). It also has the two fixes that until now were only in `rolling`, for large-folder syncs on slow storage and for a single `nats: timeout` that could stop the server. `rolling` stays on OpenCloud 9.2.
- **Existing OpenCloud 7.2 installs upgrade by themselves.** On its first start with OpenCloud 9, the container applies OpenCloud's own config migration once and keeps the old `opencloud.yaml` as a backup next to it. It then fills the new search index in the background, so older files turn up in search again. If your `opencloud.yaml` holds settings of your own, the container leaves it alone and the log tells you how to finish by hand. Please back up Config and Data before you update. The guide walks through the upgrade, and through going back if you need to.

## ⚡ Improved

- On `rolling`, a config from before OpenCloud 9 gets the same migration once, so guest links work as soon as you set `OC_ENABLE_GUEST_LINKS=true`.
- Guide (`docs/guide.md`): a new section on moving the production channel up to OpenCloud 9.1 covers the backup, the log lines to look for, tidying up afterwards and the way back. The channel table and the advice on which channel to pick match the new line.
- The branding app is built against OpenCloud's version 8 web packages, the ones both images run.
